logger.doc:name: Log failure
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'RUN_FAILED runId=' ++ (vars.runId default 'n/a') ++ ' reportType=' ++ (vars.reportCtx.reportType default 'n/a') ++ ' periodStart=' ++ ((vars.reportCtx.periodStart default 'n/a') as String) ++ ' periodEnd=' ++ ((vars.reportCtx.periodEnd default 'n/a') as String) ++ ' error=' ++ vars.failureReason]

logger.doc:name: Could not mark FAILED
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'Could not mark run ' ++ vars.runId ++ ' FAILED: ' ++ (error.description default 'unknown')]

logger.doc:name: No run claimed
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'Failure before a run was claimed: ' ++ vars.failureReason]

email:send.doc:name: Send failure alert
email:send.subject: #[output text/plain --- 'ALERT: ' ++ (vars.reportCtx.reportType default 'Compliance') ++ ' report run FAILED - ' ++ (vars.reportCtx.entityCode default '')]

email:body.email:content:
#[output text/plain --- "The scheduled regulatory report run did not complete.

Run ID: " ++ (vars.runId default "not claimed") ++ "
Report type: " ++ (vars.reportCtx.reportType default "n/a") ++ "
Period: " ++ ((vars.reportCtx.periodStart default "n/a") as String) ++ " to " ++ ((vars.reportCtx.periodEnd default "n/a") as String) ++ "
Error: " ++ vars.failureReason ++ "

No report was issued for this period. The control timestamp was NOT advanced, so the period will be retried on the next run or by manual re-run."]

logger.doc:name: Alert could not be sent
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'Failure alert could not be sent: ' ++ (error.description default 'unknown')]
